title: OOBB bearing holders
summary: Parametric bearing holders with bearing-size, holder-style and mounting variants.
parts: The main example is the 7 × 5 6810 holder with 15 mm assembled depth. It uses two printed frame halves, two printed hub halves, one 6810 bearing, six M3 × 12 mm countersunk screws and six M3 nuts. Each holder page includes its own quantities and downloadable parts list.
assembly: Each holder page shows an assembled and exploded CAD diagram, with variant-specific steps and a necessary-parts table. Start with the 7 × 5 6810 example above, or choose another bearing and holder style in navigation.
